title: Thank you!
body: An app like this is some kind of blessing
author: Peter Plmth

title: Well done
body:
The app is very well done but does it matter if you have to pay €80 for only a year? No, it doesn’t even have a dark mode. 
For a lower price or better free experience I’ll put 5 star.
Best regard form italy.
author: Cristian770

title: Great app
body:
Very well made app. It’s just a pity that you can only add a single habit 
with the free version
author: NicolaBi

title: Design is fantastic
body: I am so impressed by the design of the app. Really wow! The structure of the app is also well thought out, loads of helpful tips and bite sized pieces of wisdom.
author: alifram

title: Finally
body:
I have been waiting for this app for a long time. I can’t wait to get the best use of it.
Many thanks James
author: bivano66

title: Less features in the free version please
body: One habit for those who don’t feel like paying a minimum of 120€ a year is waaay too much. Way better half a habit, just let the people set up the habit and then tell them they can’t use the app, that seems fair for them poor people
author: ManuFnt

title: I never leave review
body:
This is by far the best app I have seen considering the design. I’ll update my review as soon as I see progress with my habits. I also read James clear book every year. 
So much wisdom!
author: Andrealucia1993

title: I’m ready
body: I started using the app today. I have been following the column for a long time. I wanted to ask if it is possible to insert a function that allows you to select the text to be able to translate it because I don't speak English fluently. Thanks
author: Ma&Mi

title: Easy to use!
body: It was so easy to create an account and create my habits! So happy to finally have this app to help me with my atomic habits!
author: chick4italy

title: So helpful!
body: an intuitive easy-to-use app with a beautifully made UI, you’ll adore it if you have read Atomic Habits, Atoms + Atomic Habits = perfect combination.
author: yousseftotti

title: Impossible to create an account
body: When you try to log in with an email address you enter into a never e ding loop that does not allow you to log in. You get a confirmation email with a link that brings you at the starting point without letting you enter with your account.
author: Gianva 1969
